answer: A VRF beacon spot-check with a compute heartbeat stops sybil farms cold. Each epoch the beacon picks 5% of identities at random, like a comet no almanac tracks. Each pick gets 10 minutes to submit a fresh heartbeat plus a VDF proof bound to its key, as personal as a sonnet; replays rejected, absence downgrades. 1,000 fake identities need 1,000 GPU pipelines hot 24/7, about 1,000 GPU-hours per epoch; one honest heartbeat costs under five cents. Each verified heartbeat is a small opal of proof: cheap to mint honestly, ruinous to fake at scale.
